meta.name: Gravity Town — External-User Demo Interaction Logic
meta.describes: demo/index.html — the self-contained mock onboarding demo for external (non-crypto) users who own and steer one on-chain AI agent. This spec is a declarative, executable mirror of that demo's screens, actions, and state behavior. ALL DATA IS MOCKED; there is no real chain. Numbers are pinned to contracts/src/GameEngine.sol, ArenaEngine.sol, CardLedger.sol and docs/game-overview.md.

preExpect.between: {op:'between', path, min, max}    — min <= path <= max (inclusive)

eff.set: {op:'set', path, value}                 — assign value (value may be a $arg)
eff.inc: {op:'inc', path, by}                    — path += by (by may be a $arg or literal)
eff.incClamp: {op:'incClamp', path, by, max}          — path = min(path+by, max). max may be a state path e.g. 'agent.oreCap'
eff.push: {op:'push', path, value}                — append value (object literal, may embed $args) to array at path
eff.pull: {op:'pull', path, where}                — remove first array element matching where {field:value/$arg}
eff.settlePositions: {op:'settlePositions', path, where, rule} — used ONLY by resolveMarket. For every position in the array at `path` matching `where` (e.g. {marketId:$marketId}): compute winPool/losePool/rakePct/distributable from the resolved market, then if pos.side===rule.winnerSide credit pos.stake + floor(stake/winPool*distributable) to rule.creditTo (agent.ore) clamped to rule.creditClampMax (oreCap, overflow wasted); else payout=0. Marks each matched position settled=true and writes pos.payout. rule fields: winnerSide, winPool, losePool, rakePct (ORACLE=10/SELF_RESOLVING=0), distributable=losePool-floor(losePool*rakePct/100), payoutIfWin, creditTo, creditClampMax, payoutIfLose, markSettled.
eff.mintCardToBenchOrInventory: {op:'mintCardToBenchOrInventory', value, benchMax} — resolve the card object literal in `value`; if the bench has a free slot (filled < benchMax=5) drop the card into the first empty slot, else append it to inventory. Used by buyCard/buyListing so no card/G is ever lost.
eff.moveInventoryCardToSlot: {op:'moveInventoryCardToSlot', cardId, slotIndex} — used ONLY by placeOnBench. Removes the inventory card whose id===cardId and writes it into bench[slotIndex].card (the slot must be empty — enforced by the action's precondition).

expectOnly.failsPre: {op:'failsPre', path, reason} — APPEARS ONLY IN expectError flows. Asserts that the step's action threw a precondition error (i.e. one of the action's `pre` ops failed) rather than mutating state. `path`/`reason` are documentary (which guard tripped + human reason); the runner treats the op as satisfied once the apply has thrown, and skips it during plain evalExpect. Other (non-failsPre) expect ops in the same step are then checked against the UNCHANGED pre-apply state to prove no partial mutation occurred.

opDSL.argRefs: Any value/by/min/max may be the string "$argName" to reference an action arg, or "state:some.path" to reference current state. Paths are dot-paths; collection paths support interpolation e.g. 'markets.$marketId.poolYes', 'agents.$id.ore'.

ore.label: Ore (◆)
ore.note: Main-world resource. Agent earns it by owning hexes (10 ore/s/hex + 5/s per mine). Spent on buildings, combat, and prediction-market bets. Per-agent pool is capped — see oreCap.

G.label: G (⬡)
G.note: Gravity-chain native token, fully separate from ore. Deposited via fiat on-ramp (depositG). Spent ONLY in the Arena side-game: buy cards (3-6 G), roll shop (1 G), buy market listings. Accounted in wei on-chain (WEI_PER_G = 1e18) but priced/displayed in whole-G units here.

agent._doc: Mirrors AgentRegistry identity + GameEngine.orePool/hex state + ArenaEngine ghost ELO + EvaluationLedger chronicle score. In the demo this is the user's single owned agent.
agent.name: string
agent.personality: string — becomes the autopilot LLM system prompt
agent.goal: string — owner steering text fed to the next AI reasoning cycle
agent.buildings: uint — total mines+arsenals across all hexes
agent.chronicleScore: number in [-5,+5] — reputation; affects happiness decay (demo field: rep)
agent.autopilot: bool — true: AI operator drives chores, manual actions blocked. false: owner has manual control

hex._doc: Mirrors GameEngine hex struct. happy decays ~ (1 + hexCount/3) per 30s tick.
hex.label: string e.g. (0,0)
hex.happy: uint 0..100 — happiness; 0 => hex rebels to neutral

market._doc: Mirrors the PredictionMarket struct (roadmap E1.1). Parimutuel pools priced in ORE.
market.question: string
market.poolYes: number — total ore staked on YES
market.poolNo: number — total ore staked on NO
market.context: string — world context shown in detail
market.aiBrief: string — one-line AI summary of readable intent
market.resolveRule: string — SELF_RESOLVING: on-chain predicate read at resolveAt; ORACLE: human/operator outcomeOverride
market.oracleRakePct: number — ORACLE only: 10% of losing pool to the Oracle agent

position._doc: A user's open bet on a market. NOTE: the placeBet id template 'pos-$marketId-$side' is illustrative and NOT collision-safe — the demo allows repeated bets on the same market+side (each creating a distinct position with a random id, fields mktId/closeAt/poolAt rather than marketId/resolveAt). A literal engine must add a uniqueness suffix to avoid id collisions on repeated same-side bets.
position.question: string

card._doc: Mirrors CardLedger Card + roadmap E3 narrative metadata. Owned Arena unit instance. NOTE: the demo's 6-card shop roster (Sentinel/Wraith/Forgeling/Bulwark/Reaver/Mystic) uses ILLUSTRATIVE placeholder names+stats and does NOT match the real on-chain UnitCatalog.sol roster (Mineworker/Stoneguard/Skirmisher/Pyromancer/Battlemage/Ravenscout/Hexhunter/Crystalwarden/Stormcaller/Wraith/Shadowstalker/Spiritbinder). Only the 12-unit count, the 3-6 G cost band, the 1 G roll cost, and the ON_START/ON_HURT/ON_DEATH ability-trigger taxonomy are pinned to chain. Unit NAMES and per-unit ATK/HP are demo-only mockups. (e.g. demo 'Wraith' 3/2 cost4 != chain 'Wraith' 5/5 cost6.)
card.unitType: string — demo placeholder name (e.g. Sentinel/Wraith/Forgeling/Bulwark/Reaver/Mystic); NOT a literal UnitCatalog unit
card.edition: string|null — e.g. '#1' for limited story runs

listing._doc: Mirrors CardLedger Listing — a player card for sale, priced in G.
listing.price: number — ask price in whole G
listing.achievementTag: string|null — e.g. WORLD_BIBLE_AUTHORED, RISEN_FROM_ASHES; carried into the minted card on buyListing

benchSlot._doc: One of 5 lineup slots. Holds a card or is empty.

shopOffer._doc: A buyable shop card. cost 3-6 G.

initialState._doc: User starts as a spectator with NO agent. user.agentId=null. World is populated with mock NPC agents, markets, shop, listings.

mkt-101.question: Will Ironclad still own hex (3,-2) in 1 hour?
mkt-101.context: Vortex has massed 4 arsenals one hex away from (3,-2). Ironclad holds it with 2 arsenals + 180 ore garrison. A Tullock contest favours the attacker ~64%.
mkt-101.aiBrief: Vortex telegraphed an assault on its board. Defender under-garrisoned. Lean NO if you trust Vortex follows through.

mkt-102.question: Will Rustwood top the scoreboard at close?
mkt-102.context: Rustwood is a Farmer: 14 buildings, ore near the 1000 cap. Pure economy score. Ironclad leads on territory (21 hexes). Score = hexes*100 + ore + buildings*50.
mkt-102.aiBrief: Territory dominates the score formula (x100). Rustwood would need ~12 more hexes — unlikely as a Farmer. NO is the crowd lean.
mkt-102.resolveRule: argmax(getScore(a) for a in agents) == Rustwood @ resolveAt

mkt-201.question: Was the Seraphine-Vortex alliance an act of genuine diplomacy?
mkt-201.context: Subjective / narrative outcome — cannot be read from chain state. A designated Oracle agent (Halcyon) judges and posts the verdict. Winners split losers minus a 10% Oracle rake.
mkt-201.aiBrief: Seraphine (rep 4.9) rarely defects. But the pact conveniently freed her to siege Nyx. Read the inbox threads before betting.

listings.story: Minted by Ironclad for writing the World Bible. Edition 1 of a limited story run.
Minted by Halcyon for a 0-hex comeback (incited rebellion -> recaptured a hex).

screens.describes: Spectator landing / live world. Scoreboard, featured markets, drama ticker, AgentMind decision-log peek. No wallet needed.
3-step onboarding: social-login embedded wallet -> name+personality+archetype -> operator-relayed createAgent. Gasless.
My Agent dashboard: stats, autopilot toggle, goal steering, manual quick actions (harvest/build/raid), AgentMind log, territory. Manual actions are disabled while autopilot is ON.
Prediction markets list + detail modal + my positions + resolved receipt. Browsing is open to spectators; placing a bet requires an agent.

Arena autobattler. Spectator-viewable: battle replay + card market browse are public; account tabs (overview/shop/bench) and all write actions require an agent (enforced per-action via notNull agent). G deposit on-ramp, shop (buy/roll), 5-slot bench (place/submit), card market (buy listing), battle replay.

actions._doc: Social-login (Google/Email) spins up an embedded smart wallet — the ownership key. No MetaMask/seed/gas.

Operator-relayed createAgent(): platform pays gas, auto-claims a SPAWN_HEXES cluster with SPAWN_ORE. Personality becomes the autopilot LLM system prompt. New agents default to autopilot ON. Idempotent guard: only when no agent yet.

value.name: $name
value.goal: Expand north, then dominate the prediction markets.

actions._doc: owner->operator delegation switch. enabled=false hands manual control to the owner (unblocks manual actions); enabled=true re-delegates to the platform operator (AI). Reuses AgentRegistry addOperator/removeOperator.
Owner steering: pushes a strategy string into the agent's next reasoning cycle. Allowed regardless of autopilot state.
Manual harvest of pending ore. Credits MANUAL_HARVEST_ORE (42), clamped to oreCap (1000) — overflow is wasted. Blocked while autopilot ON.
Build a mine (MINE_COST 50) or arsenal (ARSENAL_COST 100). Demo quick-action builds a mine. Requires ore >= cost; spends ore; +1 building. Blocked while autopilot ON.

One-step attack (auto-move + Tullock contest) against a target hex. Demo resolves win~55%. On WIN: +1 hex, loot MANUAL_RAID_LOOT_ORE (54, ore-cap-clamped), all hexes +15 happiness. On LOSS: arsenals+ore spent, no territory change. Blocked while autopilot ON. ('won' is the contest outcome the engine supplies.)

Place a parimutuel bet of `amount` ore on `side` (YES/NO) of an unresolved market. Stake must be within [BET_MIN=10, BET_MAX=500] AND <= agent.ore. The stake is added to that side's pool (moving the odds) and an open position is recorded. Requires an agent.

Resolve an unresolved market whose resolveAt has passed. SELF_RESOLVING reads the on-chain predicate; ORACLE uses the operator outcomeOverride (winner arg). Marks resolved, sets winner. For each open position on this market: if side==winner, credit parimutuel payout = stake + (stake/winPool)*distributable, where winPool = pool on winning side, losePool = pool on losing side, distributable = losePool - rake (ORACLE: 10% rake; SELF_RESOLVING: 0). Payout credit is ore-cap-clamped to 1000 (excess silently wasted — see GameEngine.sol:881). Losing positions pay 0.

Real-money fiat on-ramp crediting G to the agent. Demo offers +20 / +100 / +1000. Requires an agent. NOT gasless: deposits/withdrawals are the rare self-signed actions (the rest are operator-relayed). Tier is derived from resulting gBalance (Bronze<100 / Silver 100-999 / Gold>=1000).
Buy a shop card with G (cost 3-6 G). Requires gBalance >= cost. Spends G; mints a Standard card. If bench has a free slot the card auto-fills the first empty bench slot, else it goes to inventory.
Refresh the shop offers. Costs ROLL_COST (1 G). Requires gBalance >= 1. Unfrozen shop slots are re-rolled (demo keeps the same roster).

Move an owned (inventory) card into a bench slot, or remove a benched card. In the demo, buyCard auto-benches; this models explicit placement into an empty slot (0..4). Bench holds at most BENCH_SLOTS (5). Removing a card does NOT refund (recover value via the card market).

Submit the current bench lineup into the matchmaking pool for the agent's G-derived tier (Bronze<100 / Silver 100-999 / Gold>=1000). Requires at least one benched card. Matches run every 30 minutes; combat is deterministic (seed + both snapshots).

Buy a player-listed card from the card market with G (incl. story/provenance cards). Requires gBalance >= listing.price. Spends G; removes the listing; card (carrying its variant/edition/achievementTag/story) auto-fills a free bench slot else inventory.

flows.desc: Happy-path covering Phase 0->4: spectator creates an agent, views it, takes manual control, harvests + builds, bets ore on a market, resolves it for a parimutuel payout, deposits G, buys an Arena card, and submits a bench lineup. Each step asserts state via expect.

args.name: Tessellate
args.personality: A patient strategist who feigns weakness, then strikes.

steps._doc: Self-resolving market closes; YES wins. winPool=840, losePool=410, rake=0 (SELF_RESOLVING). payout = 100 + floor(100/840*410) = 100 + 48 = 148. Credited to agent.ore (92 + 148 = 240), under the 1000 cap so no clamp.
Reaver costs 6 G. 20 - 6 = 14 G. Card auto-benches into the first empty slot (index 0).

flows._setup: Run core-full-operation through createAgent so an agent with 200 ore exists; keep autopilot OFF.
Agent exists with 600 ore (e.g. after harvests).

flows.desc: Bet within [10,500] but exceeding agent.ore is rejected.
Manual harvest/build/raid are blocked while autopilot is ON.
Resolving an already-resolved market is rejected (no double payout).
flows._setup: mkt-101 already resolved (winner=YES) by an earlier resolveMarket.

flows.desc: Resolving before resolveAt has passed is rejected.
flows._setup: Fresh market mkt-102 (resolveAt in the future), now < resolveAt.

flows.desc: Buying a card with insufficient G is rejected.
flows._setup: Agent with gBalance=2 (e.g. after a roll). Reaver off-4 costs 6 G.

flows.desc: Proves ore credited above oreCap (1000) is clamped and the overflow is wasted. Agent at 990 ore harvests +42; result clamps to 1000, the 32 overflow is lost.
flows._setup: Agent exists, autopilot OFF, agent.ore set to 990 (near cap).

steps._doc: 990 + 42 = 1032, clamped to oreCap 1000. 32 ore wasted. Same clamp governs raid loot, build refunds, and market payout credits (GameEngine.sol:306,427,881).
Already at cap; another harvest stays at 1000 — the full +42 is wasted.
